notes: The Recreation Commission's minutes for 1948 and 1949, the first two years of the 1947 recreation bond program: architect contracts (nearly all to William G. Merchant), construction contracts for field houses, clubhouses and recreation centers, demolitions on new sites, and the Funston and North Beach ceremonies. Many meeting headings are lost to OCR; dates were fixed by weekday (the commission met on Thursdays), resolution number order and the dates of bid openings.

coverage.remaining: Routine items not curated. Not placed: the Wawona clubhouse (Wawona Street at 20th Avenue, Adam Arras & Son, 1949), whose page is unclear and whose meeting date conflicts with its bid date; Merchant's 1948 contracts for Richmond Playground (two Richmond pages), Phelan Beach and the addition at Gough, Golden Gate, Laguna and Turk; and his 1949 Visitacion Valley clubhouse contract.
coverage.note: Curated list F1948.py; meetings by split.py and when.py.
